name: Nalet's Park
source:
Hennalin, a public servant from Vekpoji, is sent to the newly incorporated city of Tuhia to help complete this process among many others. Li meets a wolf in the park on lunch break which grows into something new for lir. How will this relationship work out as tensions in the city raise and discrimination grows?

[From [url=https://xtmva.itch.io/nalets-park]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来自维克波吉的公务员亨纳林被派往新成立的图希亚市，帮助完成这一过程以及其他许多过程。午休时，李在公园里遇见了一只狼，这对李来说有了新的认识。随着城市紧张局势加剧和歧视加剧，这种关系将如何发展？

[来自[url=https://xtmva.itch.io/nalets-park]Itch.io[/url]]
